paths.description: Homepage and primary browse listing; represents the main discovery journey.
Best-videos listing; represents archive/category listing templates.
Representative video detail/player page; tests media semantics and metadata without starting playback.
Account sign-in/sign-up surface; represents forms, validation, autofill, and account flow.
Synthetic missing route; tests HTTP/error recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Homepage does not follow the operating-system color preference
findings.evidence: A mobile screenshot under prefers-color-scheme: dark remains a light gray/white surface. The page offers a manual theme control but does not initially follow the emulated preference.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and initialize theme from prefers-color-scheme while preserving the user override.

findings.summary: Age gate is implemented as a custom overlay rather than a dialog primitive
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows #disclaimer_background and #disclaimer_message are div elements; the page contains zero dialog and popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a modal <dialog> with an accessible name, focus containment, and explicit close/accept behavior.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on many primary controls
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline-style none on language, location, category, search, account, theme and numerous category controls; Lighthouse also found unnamed controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and verify the entire browse and account journeys by keyboard.

findings.summary: Mobile load misses the LCP target
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 6.1 s, FCP at 4.2 s, and Time to Interactive at 11.7 s. The separate trace was faster (LCP 2.01 s), showing variability but not clearing the throttled mobile result.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP thumbnail/hero request, reduce render-blocking work, and retest on mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Homepage image delivery is unbounded and poorly responsive
findings.evidence: HAR captured 122 requests and 2,823,331 transferred bytes, including 106 images. The image probe found 99 images without dimensions, 90 below-fold images without lazy loading, 100 without srcset, and 99 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, below-fold lazy loading, modern encodings, and explicit priority only for the LCP image.

findings.summary: Large amounts of JavaScript and CSS are unused on initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 579 KiB of unused JavaScript and 206 KiB of unused CSS; the largest script transfers 516,656 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific bundles, defer optional player code until needed, and remove or conditionally load unused styles.

findings.summary: Core image links and controls lack accessible names
findings.evidence: The image probe found 98 of 100 images missing alt text. Lighthouse failed image-alt (100 nodes), button-name (2 nodes), and link-name (2 nodes), including the gate close control and pagination.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful thumbnails alt text or an equivalent link name, label icon-only controls, and hide purely decorative images.

findings.summary: Age/cookie notice text narrowly fails minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured #777 text on white at 4.47:1 for 12 px text, below the 4.5:1 threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the notice text and test normal, high-contrast, and forced-colors modes.

findings.summary: Primary templates lack a coherent heading hierarchy
findings.evidence: The rendered homepage and best listing contain no h1-h3 headings; the detail starts at h2 and the account page uses h3 headings without an h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template and nest section headings in order; retain landmarks and visible focus.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled and the representative video has no caption track
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1. The detail probe found one video with zero <track> elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove zoom restrictions and provide synchronized caption/subtitle tracks for published video media.

findings.summary: The page uses a deprecated media-controls customization
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports use of the deprecated -internal-media-controls-overlay-cast-button selector instead of disableRemotePlayback.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the standard disableRemotePlayback attribute and remove the internal pseudo-element dependency.

findings.summary: One interactive footer anchor has no href
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a footer-toggle <a> with aria-controls but no href, so it is not crawlable and has mismatched semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a button for panel toggling, or provide a real destination href if it is navigation.

findings.summary: Redirected hostname lacks an explicit canonical link
findings.evidence: The requested xvideos2.com URL redirects to xvideos.com; the rendered homepage probe found no rel=canonical despite robots.txt and sitemap.xml being present.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish an absolute canonical URL for each public template and keep redirect, sitemap, and canonical host signals aligned.

findings.summary: Homepage lacks social and structured metadata
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD. The detail page does provide VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata, so coverage is template-dependent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD and share-preview metadata to index/listing templates.

findings.summary: Transport security policy is incomplete and CSP is weak
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, or Permissions-Policy. CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval and has an unusually broad source allowlist.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS and nosniff, define a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and migrate CSP to nonces/hashes without unsafe-eval.

findings.summary: Account authentication does not expose a passkey option
findings.evidence: The account surface offers password plus Google/X sign-in; DOM and form probes found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance. No permission prompt fired on page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication as a phishing-resistant option, requested only in the account context.

findings.summary: Sign-in and sign-up fields omit key autocomplete tokens
findings.evidence: The form probe found empty autocomplete values on sign-in email/password and sign-up email/profile/password fields; only hidden new-password controls declare a token.
findings.suggestedFix: Set username/email, current-password, new-password and other appropriate autocomplete tokens on the visible fields.

findings.summary: Asset strategy wastes bandwidth on a dense listing
findings.evidence: The 2.82 MB homepage transfer is dominated by 1.72 MB of images and 760 KB of scripts; 99 images use legacy formats and 90 below-fold images load eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit page-weight budget and combine responsive modern images, lazy loading, and conditional script delivery.

findings.summary: Browse templates are visually dense and give little hierarchy to content
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show stacked global navigation rows, controls, badges, and a 100-thumbnail feed; the homepage has no headings to break the stream into understandable sections.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce duplicate chrome, establish section headings, and progressively reveal secondary filters and navigation.
